newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Uhispank shines in moderate Estonia share trade.
newsitem.headline: Uhispank shines in moderate Estonia share trade.

text.p: Moderate volumes saw Uhispank gain five kroons on Monday on the Tallinn bourse but investors are still holding back until banking sector results are released this week, dealers said.
The Talse gained by 1.61 percent to close on 265.83 kroons with 40 million kroons of shares traded on the main list.
"It was better than last week, but it was still quiet," one trader said.
"Investors are still waiting and there is an expectation that the market will move upwards after the banking sector's April results," he added.
Hansapank turned over 23.1 million kroons of shares to gain 1.03 kroons to close on 137.91 kroons.
Uhispank gained quickly in morning trade to close at 56.00 kroons after rising 5.25 kroons on 6.7 million kroons.
"Uhispank had been pushed down during last week and mixed with low liquidity it was free to move higher again," another dealer said.
The over-the-counter market trade saw 6.4 million kroons of shares change hands with diversified industrialist Norma the most active stock.
Norma ended up at 76.25 kroons, an increase of 1.10 kroons, after turning over 3.3 million kroons.
Norma announced that it had reached a supply agreement with Russian car maunfacturer Auto Vaz which would increase Norma's supply of seat belts by 20 percent.
"It was fundamtentally good news for the company, but it was also expected as Auto Vaz is increasing production after its recent year's difficulties," one analyst said.
